t:
Identify the general exclusions in a Contractor's All Risk (CAR) insurance policy?

I. Liabilities due to accident caused by vehicles licensed for general road use
II. Loss due to Collision
III. Cost for rectification of error occurred during construction
e: Correct answer: I and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: ____________ is the checking of parts, elements and /or production lines of insured property under full or partial load and normal or simulated operating conditions including the use of feedstock or other material for normal processing or other media for load simulation.
e: Correct answer: Hot Testing (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
From the option given below, suggest the correct use of engines such as steam, gas, diesel or petrol engines.

I. They are used for generation of steam at pressure
II. They are used for driving machines
III. For storage of steam, liquids and gases under pressure
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Reneissance Limited is a construction company. It has taken a Contractor's Plant and Machinery (CPM) insurance policy for all its sites. It has incurred the following losses at one of its sites. Which of the following losses are general exclusions as per a CPM insurance policy?

I. Loss of tools whilst working underground
II. Loss due to curfew imposed by government
III. Damage due to subsistence
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following are examples of operational phase policies?

I. Civil Engineering Completed Risks (CECR) insurance
II. Machinery Loss of Profits
III. Advance Loss of Profits (ALOP)
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In an ALOP Policy, how is the sum insured calculated if it is on Annual Gross Profit basis?
o: Amortisation of machinery plus interest cost
e: Correct answer: Turnover minus variable cost (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
LML Inc wants to take a Boiler and pressure Plant Insurance policy. Suggest to them the optional covers available under the policy.

I. Damage to boilers
II. Damage to pressure plant
III. Liability for personal injury
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following shall constitute as electronic equipment for an Electronic Equipment Insurance?

I. Compressors
II. Telephone handsets
III. Monitors
e: Correct answer: II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following are special exclusions in a Comprehensive project (CP) insurance?

I. Directional drilling
II. Drilling rigs and equipment
III. Piling, foundation and retaining wall construction work
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Engineering insurance can be broadly classified into _______.
o: Contructional phase insurance and Operational phase insurance
e: Correct answer: Contructional phase insurance and Operational phase insurance (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following losses shall be covered under Electronic Equipment insurance?

I. Sudden physical damage to the equipment while it is being shifted
II. Normal wear and tear to the equipment's due to use
III. Sudden damage to the software installed on the computer
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Rekha has taken a Contractor's Plant and Machinery (CPM) Insurance to cover damages to her machinery. She wants to know that in case of a total damage to the machinery how will his claim be settled. Advise.
o: Actual value of the machinery  immediately before
Actual value of the machinery immediately before the occurrence of the loss Less Value of the salvage
Market price of the machinery at the date of damag
e: Correct answer: Actual value of the machinery immediately before the occurrence of the loss Less Value of the salvage (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following statements are true in case of Contractor's All Risk (CAR) insurance policies?

I. Phased handing over is quite common in civil engineering projects
II. The liability of the insurer ceases for that section of the work taken over by the principal
III. The liability of the insurer continues for the whole project till the complete handling is done
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t: The New India Assurance Co. Ltd. started transacting engineering Insurance on a modest scale in 1953 with the technical assistance of ___________.
o: The Oriental Fire and General Insurance Co. Ltd.
e: Correct answer: Munich Reinsurance Co (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
RTH Insurance have consumed its automatic reinsurance capacity. Which reinsurance arrangement will be more suitable in this situation?

I. Surplus loss treaty
II. Facultative reinsurance
III. Excess of loss treaty
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Endorsements are attached to the policy document and the two together constitute evidence of insurance contract. Argue. Choose the most appropriate option.
o: This is wrong a endorsements do not have any legal
This is wrong a endorsements are informal document
e: Correct answer: Yes. This is right (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Which among the following will be eligible to take an ALOP policy?
e: Correct answer: Principal (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In the Indian context, which one of the following items is insured separately under a deterioration of Stock (DOS) Insurance?
e: Correct answer: Potatoes (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following is not included in substations?

I. Isolating switches of varying capacities
II. Boilers
III. Circuit breakers
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Under the Indian Boilers Act, the Boiler Inspector examines a boiler plant for:-

I. Examination of corrosion
II. Examination of seam
III. Amount of scales inside boiler
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the can be considered as needs to start a project?

I. To introduce new production facilities
II. Improve existing production capacities
III. To improve infrastructure aimed at socio-economic development
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Under the Comprehensive Project Insurance, a single insurance contract is issued for the whole project incorporating all participants as insured parties. Debate. Choose the most appropriate answer.
o: Under the CPI policy only the owner of the project
Under the CPI policy only the contractor or sub-co
e: Correct answer: This statement is right (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following are true with regards to operating in a new venture?

I. Tested and time proven
II. Only projected figures available
III. Product demand is uncertain
e: Correct answer: II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Which Section in Contractor's All Risk policies contains the schedule for payments of premium installment?
e: Correct answer: Endorsements (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
From the following details provided for a MLOP Policy, calculate the sum insured:-

I. Gross Profit Rs. 100 lakhs
II. Variable expenses Rs. 40 lacs
III. Standing charges Rs. 10 lakhs
e: Correct answer: Rs. 70 lakhs (from the IC77 question bank).

t: What is the quantum of liability which a direct insurance company (ceding company) takes on, known as:-
e: Correct answer: Retention limit (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
In EEI insurance, which of the following sections indemnify the damage or loss incurred due to excess moisture?

I. Material
II. External data media
III. Increased cost of working
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following factors are considered in determining retentions in a reinsurance programme?

I. Investment policy
II. Rate of return
III. Probability of loss
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which among the following risk/s is / are insurable by underwriters?

I. Trade risk due to economic reasons
II. Trade risk due to political reasons
III. Risk due to inherent testing defects that lead to material damage in accidental failure
e: Correct answer: NONE (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
The sum insured in a Comprehensive Project Insurance policy should represent the new reinstatement value of the plant including which of the following items?

I. Transportation cost to site
II. Customs dues
III. All installation costs
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In case of CPI policy, how is the amount of claim calculated in case of damage to insured property?
o: Expenditure incurred to rectify damage less the va
Expenditure incurred to rectify damage plus the va
Expenditure incurred to rectify damage plus costs of erection and freight less the value of reusable components and salvage materials
Expenditure incurred to rectify damage less the co
e: Correct answer: Expenditure incurred to rectify damage plus costs of erection and freight less the value of reusable components and salvage materials (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Engineering Insurance forms part of which branch of insurance in the Indian insurance market?
e: Correct answer: Miscellaneous (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Identify the odd man out.
e: Correct answer: Retrocession (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following losses shall be covered under machinery insurance?

I. Physical damage to the machinery due to self heating
II. Physical damage due to centrifugal force
III. Damage due to lightning
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Five sets of Endorsement wordings are available from the London Market for the Defect Exclusion (D.E.) Wordings. Which set pertains to outright defect exclusion?
e: Correct answer: DE 1 (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Which of the following plant, machinery or equipment is used for storage of steam, liquids and gases under pressure?
o: Engines such as steam, gas, diesel or petrol engin
e: Correct answer: Pressure plant (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following needs are addressed in Erection All Risk (EAR) insurance policy?

I. Installation of mechanical plant
II. Testing of plants
III. Maintenance of plant
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Five sets of Endorsement wordings are available from the London Market for the Defect Exclusion (D.E.) Wordings. The set DE1 pertains to ____________.
e: Correct answer: Outright defects exclusion (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
LHT Insurance have consumed its automatic reinsurance capacity. Which reinsurance arrangement will be more suitable in this situation?

I. Facultative reinsurance
II. Quota share treaty
III. Excess of loss treaty
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following are examples of construction phase policies?

I. Contract Works (CW) Insurance
II. Marine Cum Erection (MCE) Insurance
III. Advance Loss Of Profits (ALOP)
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Sanjay is a project manager for an commercial engine manufacturing company. He is incharge of a project. Advise him after which stage can he invites tenders for construction of project building?
e: Correct answer: Detailed project planning (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Any physical damage to the machine while being shifted outside the premises shall be covered in the machinery insurance policy. Debate. (Choose the most appropriate answer)
o: Non-physical damage while being shifted shall be c
Any kind of damage while being shifted outside the premises shall not be covered
e: Correct answer: Any kind of damage while being shifted outside the premises shall not be covered (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Which section of a typical engineering insurance policy is affixed by the company's official seal?
e: Correct answer: Signature clause (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Unitech limited is a housing construction company. It has taken a Contractor's All Risk (CAR) insurance policy for all its sites. It has incurred the following losses at one of its sites. Which of the following losses are general exclusions in a Contractor's All Risk (CAR) insurance policy?

I. Damages due to accident on site because of defective cement
II. Damage of glass panes which had to be installed in a building
III. Theft of architectural drawings from site office
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following are some of the unsatisfactory features of process plant from machinery insurance angle?

I. Replacement of parts at frequent intervals is a common feature
II. Less care and maintenance is normally applied on process machinery
III. Depreciation and obsolescence are usually at a slower rate
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following losses and damages shall be covered under the Comprehensive Project Insurance policy?

I. Loss or damage due to war
II. Loss or damage due collision
III. Loss or damage due to theft or burglary
e: Correct answer: II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: PQR Ltd has a sum insured of Rs. 10 crore, net retention of Rs. 1 crore and a five line surplus treaty. PQR wants to insure the balance if any through a facultative reinsurance. Calculate the facultative cover which they might have to take.
e: Correct answer: Rs. 4 crore (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following statement/s is/are true for a standard EAR and MCE policy, containing endorsements regarding fire/explosions?

I. The insured should provide adequate fire fighting equipment's and extinguishing agents of sufficient capacity at the site
II. Open storage of construction materials at the site is divided into sub-units which should be separated from each other by a distance of at least 50 meters
III. Inflammable liquids and gases should never be stored on construction sites
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In a comprehensive project insurance policy, the details of 'delay in start-up insurance' are mentioned in which section?
e: Correct answer: Section 3 (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Which of the following is one of the causes of the insulation break down of electric motors and generators?
e: Correct answer: High temperature (from the IC77 question bank).
